title: Current watches, warnings, and advisories for Texas

properties.headline: Excessive Heat Warning issued for Travis County until 9 PM CDT
properties.description: Dangerously hot conditions with heat index values up to 112 expected. Extreme heat and humidity will significantly increase the potential for heat-related illnesses, particularly for those working or participating in outdoor activities and those without effective cooling or adequate hydration.

properties.headline: Heat Advisory issued for Williamson County until 8 PM CDT
properties.description: Heat index values up to 105 expected. Drink plenty of fluids, stay in an air-conditioned room, stay out of the sun.
